name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe Oven-Roasted Turkey Breast Sandwich
brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Lean sliced turkey breast on soft white/brioche bread is non-greasy, dairy-free, and easy to pack in your park bag for a mid-day meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Oven-Roasted Turkey Sandwich (or the Kids' Turkey Sandwich with applesauce/banana) and remove any raw lettuce or tomato slices before eating.
watchOuts: Remove raw lettuce and tomato slices; ask for mustard/mayo packets on the side
